caption: The drawing consists of two main elements: an upper portion and a lower portion. In the upper part of the drawing, there is a simple, thin-lined outline of a wide-mouthed container or crock, viewed from the side and labeled with the number "2" near the top. Inside the outline of the container, there is a small line drawing of a bird, standing to the right, with a long beak and tail, and it is perched on a branch with a few leaves. The lower part of the drawing, occupying a larger area and placed over a light rectangular beige background, features a larger depiction of the same bird. This bird, drawn in flowing, bold black brushstrokes, faces right and perches on a looping, curved branch. The details of the wings, tail, and head are accentuated with dark lines, while the body and the branch show flowing, gestural lines. The background of the main section is a faint tan or light brown rectangular wash that highlights the central bird image. There is a handwritten signature in the bottom left corner of the page.
title: Crock
